issue.title: nav-hotkeys [unblocked::] recovery ignores Today and planned-today membership

task_type_fields.impact: Low-to-moderate: a Today-linked or snoozed task recovered by a nav gesture becomes an unblock TICKLER (returned_by: unblocked) once it leaves today's plan, re-entering the `]s` review a day early, and plugin/CLI recovery writes disagree on identical inputs. Fix: resolve membership per recovered task (ledger `api.isPlannedToday({path, blockLink})` where available, falling back to `isToday`) inside nav's markUnblockedLine wrapper or navNoteScopeFlags callers, and add Today-linked and snoozed recovery tests.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/260-project-schedules.js navNoteScopeFlags / navFreshnessMarkUnblockedLine and their callers
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by the bob-cli-q5.4.1 land agent while verifying phase bob-cli-q5.4.1.2's PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #4 (gesture callers that still use Today-only predicates).

Rust `freshness::placement::mark_unblocked` skips the automatic `[unblocked::]` write when `UnblockScope.is_today || is_snoozed_today` (src/native/freshness/placement.rs ~L245; callers in task_complete/project_close.rs and task_status_hooks/sync.rs pass both flags). bob-ledger-tools `markUnblockedLine` honors `isToday` and `isSnoozedToday` the same way (080-freshness-placement.js, SP14).

bob-navigation-hotkeys never supplies either flag. `navNoteScopeFlags(notePath, overrides)` in src/260-project-schedules.js defaults `isToday: false` and none of its ~17 callers (084, 087, 420, 430, 500, 550, 560, 570, 580, 600 fragments) passes membership, so every nav-driven Blocked→Ready recovery (dependency/tie removal, prerequisite cancel or roll, project schedule recovery) stamps `[unblocked:: today]` on a recovered task even when it has a live Task Link under today's open Pomodoros or a live/blocked row in today's `## Snoozed`.

Repro (code reading plus a harness test): in the nav harness, give a `[?]` task with an older `[fresh::]` a live Today link (or an active Snoozed row) and remove its last dependency via a nav gesture. The recovered `[ ]` line gains `[unblocked:: <today>]`; the CLI path (`bob task complete` of the prerequisite, or reconcile) leaves it without the field.

issue.creation_reason: Found while landing bob-cli-q5.4.1: nav-driven Blocked-to-Ready recovery stamps [unblocked::] on Today-linked and snoozed tasks, diverging from Rust mark_unblocked and the plugin SP14 contract; the Today half predates the snooze epic.
